Module np.cincuentazo
Package np.cincuentazo.model

Class Player

java.lang.Object
np.cincuentazo.model.Player
All Implemented Interfaces:
Playable
Direct Known Subclasses:
HumanPlayer, MachinePlayer
public abstract class Player extends Object implements Playable
Abstract base class for all Cincuentazo players. Implements Playable to enforce the contract for card selection. Both HumanPlayer and MachinePlayer extend this class.

    • selectCard

      public abstract Card selectCard(int cardIndex, int tableSum) throws InvalidPlayException
      Selects and returns a card from the player's hand. Concrete implementations define the selection strategy (human: UI-driven; machine: automatic).
      Specified by:
      selectCard in interface Playable
      Parameters:
      cardIndex - zero-based index of the card to play
      tableSum - the current table sum
      Returns:
      the played card (removed from hand)
      Throws:
      InvalidPlayException - if the card would cause the sum to exceed 50
